# hvrg_retention (Resource)

The retention records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `days` (Number) days the class is kept
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `signal` (String) logs, metrics, traces, records, metrics_1h, alert_delivery or ai_log

### Optional

- `class` (String) the retention class the days apply to, default when unnamed; with signal the key, signal/class
